title: Tool Service commands
description: Requests and responses of the tool service's control subjects: `oe.v1.tools.apply`, `oe.v1.tools.delete`, `oe.v1.tools.invoke.{namespace}.{name}`, `oe.v1.toolgrants.apply`, `oe.v1.toolgrants.delete` and `oe.v1.toolinvocations.cancel`. Payload fields are camelCase, like the resources they carry.

resource_key.description: A namespaced resource, by namespace and name.

apply_tool_payload.description: Create or update the Tool named by `tool.metadata.namespace` and `tool.metadata.name`. The adapter validates `executor`, `configuration` and `execution` before the command is accepted; a configuration it cannot honour, including an unsupported `recovery`, is rejected with INVALID_ARGUMENT. A changed `spec` increments `metadata.generation`; invocations already accepted keep the definition they resolved.

delete_tool_payload.description: Delete a Tool. New invocations of it are refused; accepted ones keep the definition they resolved but are dispatched only while their grants still allow them. A Tool created later under the same name has a new `uid`, and no existing grant covers it.

invoke_tool_payload.description: Call the Tool the subject names. The workspace comes from the caller's verified credentials, never from the payload. Rejected with NOT_FOUND for an unknown tool, INVALID_STATE when it is not Ready, PERMISSION_DENIED without an active grant for the workspace or step, and INVALID_ARGUMENT when `arguments` fail the tool's `inputSchema` or the grant's constraints. Accepted means a ToolInvocation named `invocationId` was recorded.

invocationId.description: The caller's name for the invocation, unique in the namespace; it becomes the ToolInvocation's `metadata.name`.

apply_tool_grant_payload.description: Create or update a ToolGrant. Only trusted control-plane callers may, usually the Graph Engine applying a Graph step's `agent.tools`; anyone else is rejected with PERMISSION_DENIED. Rejected with NOT_FOUND when the tool does not exist, INVALID_ARGUMENT when the adapter rejects `constraints`, and PERMISSION_DENIED when a step's grant would exceed what the control plane allows its workspace. The grant is bound to the tool's current `uid`.

delete_tool_grant_payload.description: Revoke a ToolGrant. Only trusted control-plane callers may. Invocations it allowed that have not been dispatched are refused when they are rechecked.

cancel_tool_invocation_payload.description: Cancel an invocation, by namespace and `invocationId`. One not yet dispatched ends `Cancelled`; a running attempt is asked to stop, and if its effect cannot be determined the invocation ends `OutcomeUnknown` instead. A finished invocation is rejected with INVALID_STATE. Completes with `toolinvocation.cancelled`.

tool_command_response.description: Reply to every tool service command. `resource_id` is the `uid` of the resource the command created or affects: the Tool, the ToolGrant or the ToolInvocation.
